newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European vegetable oils end little changed.
newsitem.headline: European vegetable oils end little changed.

text.p: The European vegetable oils market closed with prices little changed on Monday after a day when the UK bank holiday weighed on activity, traders said.

A firmer Chicago market in early business did little to move prices towards the European close. Guilder-priced soft oils traded between 0.50 firmer and 0.50 easier. Rbd palm olein attracted some interest, September trading at $577.70 and $580, October $560 and Nov/Dec $557.50 a tonne fob Malaysia.
But traders said overall activity was light, the usual Monday slowness exaggerated by the absence of British traders.
